This Indian Standard (Part 25/Sec 5) which is identical with IEC 61400-25-5 : 2017 â€˜Wind turbines â€” Part 25-5: Communications for monitoring and control of wind power plants â€” Conformance testingâ€™ issued by the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on recommendation of the Wind Turbines Sectional Committee and approval of the Electrotechnical Division Council.This standard has been issued in several sections.
